udt_error_enum_v0.doc: All failure modes are explicit, contiguous `u32` codes so the TypeScript\nclient can map them to user-facing messages without guessing.
udt_error_enum_v0.name: Error

udt_union_v0.doc:
Storage keys. `Trip`, `Member` and `Spends` live in *persistent* storage
(they must outlive the contract instance so funds and the audit trail are
never stranded); `Admin`/`Token`/`TotalPooled` live in *instance* storage so
they share the instance TTL.
udt_union_v0.name: DataKey

void_v0.doc: Default token (the XLM Stellar Asset Contract) recorded at init.
void_v0.name: Token

void_v0.doc: Running total of all minor units ever contributed across every trip.
void_v0.name: TotalPooled

tuple_v0.doc: (trip_id, member) -> i128 lifetime contributed by that wallet.
tuple_v0.name: Member

udt_enum_v0.doc:
Lifecycle of a trip pool.
A trip starts `Open`; the organizer may `Settled` it once the journey is over.
Settling only blocks *new contributions* \xe2\x80\x94 the organizer can still spend or
refund the remaining held balance afterward.
udt_enum_v0.name: TripStatus

udt_enum_v0.doc: Whether a ledger entry was an outbound spend to a payee, or a remainder\nrefund returned to a member at trip end.
udt_enum_v0.name: SpendKind

udt_struct_v0.doc:
A single group travel fund, keyed in storage by a 32-byte `trip_id`
(the app passes `sha256(<trip UUID>)`).

The contract custodies exactly `balance` minor units of `token` for this
trip. `pooled` is the lifetime sum ever contributed (never decremented), so
the UI can always show "total pooled". `spent` + `refunded` + `balance` ==
`pooled`.
udt_struct_v0.name: Trip

fields.doc: Funds currently held in the contract for this trip (pooled - spent - refunded).
fields.name: balance

fields.doc: Number of distinct member wallets that have funded this trip.
fields.name: members

fields.doc: The organizer who opened the trip; the only address allowed to spend/refund.
fields.name: organizer

fields.doc: Lifetime total ever contributed (monotonic; survives spends/refunds).
fields.name: pooled

fields.doc: Lifetime total ever refunded to members at trip end.
fields.name: refunded

fields.doc: Number of entries recorded in the on-chain spend ledger (spends + refunds).
fields.name: spends

fields.doc: Lifetime total ever paid out to payees.
fields.name: spent

fields.doc: Stellar Asset Contract (SAC) address of the pool asset (XLM SAC by default).
fields.name: token

udt_struct_v0.doc: One immutable entry in a trip's on-chain spend ledger. Appended on every\n`spend` and `refund` and never mutated \xe2\x80\x94 this is the audit trail the whole\ngroup can read.
udt_struct_v0.name: SpendRecord

fields.doc: Amount paid out, in the token's minor units (7 dp).
fields.name: amount

fields.doc: Spend (to a payee) or Refund (remainder back to a member).
fields.name: kind

fields.doc: Ledger sequence at which the payout was recorded (on-chain timestamp).
fields.name: ledger

fields.doc: `sha256(<payout description>)` \xe2\x80\x94 ties the on-chain entry to its off-chain note.
fields.name: memo

fields.doc: Wallet the funds were paid to (a vendor payee, or a member on refund).
fields.name: payee

function_v0.doc: One-time setup. Records the admin (the deployer) and the default token\n(the XLM Stellar Asset Contract).
function_v0.name: initialize

function_v0.doc:
Open a new trip pool owned by `organizer` and denominated in `token` (the
XLM SAC by default). Fails if the id is already taken.

Auth: requires the organizer's signature.
function_v0.name: open_trip

function_v0.doc:
Contribute `amount` of the trip's token into the pool, locking it in the
contract. Tracks the trip total and the member's lifetime amount;
increments the distinct-member count on a wallet's first contribution.
Returns the new lifetime pooled total.

Auth: requires the member's signature. The same authorization covers the
inner SAC `transfer(member -> contract)`.
function_v0.name: contribute

function_v0.doc:
Spend `amount` of the held balance to `payee`, appending an immutable
`SpendRecord` (payee, amount, `memo` = sha256 of the payout note, ledger
sequence, kind=Spend) to the trip's on-chain spend ledger. Returns the
index of the new ledger entry.

Auth: requires the trip organizer's signature; cannot exceed the held
balance.
function_v0.name: spend

function_v0.doc:
Refund `amount` of the remaining held balance back to `member` at trip
end, decrementing that member's tracked contribution and appending an
immutable `SpendRecord` (kind=Refund) to the on-chain ledger. Returns the
index of the new ledger entry.

Auth: requires the trip organizer's signature; cannot exceed the member's
remaining tracked contribution nor the held balance.
function_v0.name: refund

function_v0.doc: Settle a trip: block new contributions (the organizer can still spend or\nrefund the remaining held balance afterward). Auth: trip organizer.
function_v0.name: close_trip

function_v0.doc: Replace the contract's own code (admin-gated). Enables shipping fixes\nwithout migrating trip balances.
function_v0.name: upgrade
